decisions.reason: A safety shoe line is the firm's core competence, so it can interpret market feedback and refine the line with its in-house development and manufacturing knowledge.
Comfort insoles build directly on the firm's foot-measurement and footwear knowledge and complement its shoes, so it can assimilate feedback and improve them easily.
Supportive insoles draw on the firm's existing ergonomic and foot-analysis expertise, though overlap with the other insoles makes a later consolidation somewhat possible.
The ergonomic safety shoe series has its own website page and sits at the heart of the firm's development knowledge, making it a strategic product to keep and improve.
Firefighter boots extend the firm's protective footwear expertise into a related niche with specific certification needs, and its manufacturing knowledge is sufficient to learn and adapt there.
The moulded insole is featured on the home page, signalling strategic priority, and it fits the firm's tailored foot-measurement solutions.
